title: Composition of agreement
statement: Let $K,K_1,K_2$ be predicates on the natural numbers, and let $\mu,\mu',\mu''$ be integer-valued sequences. If $\mu'$ agrees with $\mu$ at every index satisfying $K_1$, $\mu''$ agrees with $\mu'$ at every index satisfying $K_2$, and every index satisfying $K$ satisfies both $K_1$ and $K_2$, then $\mu''$ agrees with $\mu$ at every index satisfying $K$.
hypotheses_covered: Every index satisfying $K$ satisfies both $K_1$ and $K_2$
